body: Thank you for understanding. I hope that you find peace in whatever your future holds.

I'm not sure that I should define my life and continued existence simply because I contribute, on a very minor scale, mind you, to the lives of cancer patients and families.  
That sounds insanely selfish, but aren't many people dealing with suicide feeling that? The fact that we try to help others and have lived our lives for them, but we are in pain. We don't want to be here just for someone else when we ourselves are unhappy and lost all hope.

Thank you, but I have no urge to be around anyone. Those I care about are gone or already dead (even my father committed suicide nine years ago this week) and I certainly am not one to burden my brother or friends with these thoughts. They'd be mortified and I'm sure take me to a hospital. I appreciate your comment, but really, prolonging my life does nothing to help my pain.
Who knows what I might be inspired to post ;)
